judgement.summary: This is a thorough nine-section scroll plan for a reliability engineer's independent-consulting site, opening on the 2014 dropped table and closing on two explicit "write to me" paths, with per-section 3D, named fallbacks, palette, type, and a long production checklist. Its greatest weakness is the 3D: there is no single object carried through the scroll, only a series of stock infrastructure scenes (racks, cloud, line chart) whose own SVG fallbacks prove the WebGL is decoration rather than the thing telling the story.
